subject: general
question: As per the 2011 Census of India, approximately what percentage of the Indian population lives in urban areas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**31.15%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the 2011 Census of India, approximately **31.15%** of the Indian population resides in urban areas.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and provides vital statistics on the demographic profile of the country.
 
• Urban areas are defined by the Census as places with a minimum population of 5,000, at least 75% of the male working population engaged in non-agricultural activities, and a population density of at least 400 persons per square kilometer.
 
• The increase in urban population indicates the rapid urbanization and migration trends within the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• The first complete census of India was conducted in 1881, and since then, it has been conducted every decade.
 
• Data collected from the census is crucial for planning and implementation of various governmental policies, schemes, and programs aimed at the development of the country.
 
• The census provides comprehensive data on various parameters such as population size, distribution, density, growth rate, and various socio-economic indicators.
 
• Urbanization trends observed in the census data help in understanding the changing demographic patterns and the needs of urban infrastructure and services.
